text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you are presenting with generalized fatigue, severe itching, and abnormal liver function tests. To understand the underlying cause, have you noticed any jaundice, dark urine, or pale stools recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Biliary Cholangitis (PBC)
Given your age, gender, history of autoimmune disease (ulcerative colitis), and symptoms of cholestasis (pruritus, fatigue), this is highly suggestive of PBC. Have you noticed any rashes on your hands or feet, or sensitivity to sunlight?
